Title:SINGAPORE NATIONAL REFERENDUM BILL
MPs Speaking:Dr Goh Keng Swee (Minister for Finance); Mr K. M. Byrne (Minister for Health and Law); Mr Lee Khoon Choy (Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education); Mr Ong Pang Boon (Minister for Home Affairs); Mr S. Ramaswamy (Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance); Mr Yong Nyuk Lin (Minister for Education); Dr Lee Siew Choh; Dr Thio Chan Bee; Madam Chan Choy Siong; Mr A. P. Rajah; Mr Chan Sun Wing; Mr David Marshall; Mr Leong Keng Seng; Mr Lin You Eng; Mr Ong Chang Sam; Mr S. T. Bani; Mr Tan Cheng Tong; Tun Lim Yew Hock; Mr John Mammen (Deputy Speaker); Sir George Oehlers (Mr Speaker);


    Mr Lee Khoon Choy: Mr Speaker, Sir, we have heard over and over again that they want to protect parliamentary democracy. That is why I have to bring up examples to show that those who support unconstitutional actions are now describing themselves as protectors of parliamentary democracy. Just one

Column : 632

more instance; can you really believe that these people are champions of parliamentary democracy when they are led by a leader who has sworn an oath of allegiance to Joe Stalin?

    An hon. Member: Khrushchev!

    Mr Lee Khoon Choy: Mr Speaker, Sir, we have heard of parliamentary democracy[Interruption]-

    The Chairman: Order.

    Mr Lee Khoon Choy: I believe that history has proved that parliamentary democracy has failed in this part of the world. You can look around our neighbouring countries [Interruption]-
